adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb the test "raises an error with a missing host" no longer sets any host/allowlist state and also does not stub a Referer; after the change to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (embed_controller.rb), a nil referer will fail the same way as the existing "raises an error with no referer" case. Additionally, both tests only assert `expect(response).not_to be_success`, so any non-2xx response (including unrelated failures like 404) would satisfy the expectation, and there is no explicit coverage shown here for the scenario "referer present but not in embeddable_hosts table".
